name: Signed Minimal-Nonface Presentation
definition: For an ample family $C\subseteq Q_F$ with shattered complex $\Sigma$, every minimal nonface $I\in\mathcal N(\Sigma)$ has a unique omitted trace $\sigma_I(C)\in Q_I$. The signed minimal-nonface presentation is the signed clutter $\boldsymbol\sigma_C=(\sigma_I(C))_{I\in\mathcal N(\Sigma)}$.
codomain: Signings of the clutter of minimal nonfaces of a finite simplicial complex
parameters: A displayed finite ample family, up to coordinate permutation and independent coordinate sign changes.
normalization: Each clause is stored as its support $I$ and the unique trace omitted by the projection to $I$; supports form an antichain.
comments: Together with the shattered complex, this presentation determines the entire ample family. Admissibility of a signing means that its avoidance family has cardinality equal to the number of faces of the complex.
